welcome: This patch improves player discovery, fixes lost party-chat reminder choices, and improves map compatibility.

sections.title: Finding other players
items: QT now uses online friends, compatible Battle.net characters, in-game chat and visible friendly players as additional ways to discover other QT users. Your sharing preferences still apply.

Busy clients can remember incoming connection requests and give them a turn when space becomes available. Previously tried contacts also get a fairer turn in crowded areas. Both players should update for the connection fix.
Connection diagnostics now distinguish a busy client from a failed send or an unanswered request.

sections.title: Party chat reminders
items: Checking “Don’t remind me again” and choosing “Keep enabled” now saves your choice even if QT recognizes a party member at that moment. Inviting another member afterward will not reopen the reminder.
The checkbox also stays checked when QT refreshes the member list inside the same open dialog.

sections.title: Map navigation
items: Adjusted QT’s map and quest-log navigation to reduce blocked-action errors when opening the map in combat afterward.
